summary.text: Rick Gundrum is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 58, based in Slinger, first elected in a January 2018 special election.
He chairs the Committee on Jobs and Economy.

paragraphs.text: Gundrum was born in Nenno, Wisconsin, on September 4, is married, and has two stepchildren and four grandchildren.

He attended St. Kilian Catholic Grade School and Hartford Union High School, earned an associate degree at the University of Wisconsin-Washington County, and holds a B.S. in radio-TV-film from the University of Wisconsin-Oshkosh.
The Legislature's page describes him as a business owner in broadcast media.
He was elected to the Washington County Board of Supervisors, serving from 2006 to 2018 and as chair from 2016 to 2018, and to the Village of Slinger Board of Trustees from 2009 to 2023.
He was elected to the Assembly in a January 2018 special election and has been reelected since November 2018.
